items.q: And then along with a few other people in there, like Ray [De Geer] and very explosive people.

ctx.x: Yes. Although Buddy was a very orderly person. He was not -- like Dodo and Jimmy, you know, they were -- anything could happen. And then along with a few other
people in there, like Ray [De Geer] and very explosive people. Anything could happen, but no, Buddy was always very much of a gentleman.
